macOS 13+ Apple Silicon speech-to-text menu bar app (Swift 5/SwiftUI, Groq). Hold hotkey, speak, release. Before changes: `git checkout -b feature/<name>`. After Swift file changes, always run the build command above:
`xcodebuild -project whisperswift.xcodeproj -scheme whisperswift -configuration Debug build`
`xcodebuild test -project whisperswift.xcodeproj -scheme whisperswift -destination 'platform=macOS'`
`./scripts/build-with-timing.sh`
`./scripts/check-duplicates.sh`
`./scripts/generate-docs.sh`
Sandbox disabled. Carefully edit `whisperswift/whisperswift.entitlements`. Logs: `/tmp/whisperswift.log`. Read relevant docs: `docs/ARCHITECTURE.md`, `docs/BUILD_PERFORMANCE.md`, `docs/feature-flags/FEATURE_FLAGS.md`, `docs/CODE_STYLE.md`, `docs/OBSERVABILITY.md`, `docs/CI_CD.md`, `docs/RELEASE_BUILD.md`, `docs/alerting/ALERTING.md`.
